associations.where: fresh sand and gravel bars at the river edge, flooded every year
associations.source: Salicion albae softwood floodplain forest (Ellenberg 1988) and Populus deltoides-Salix bottoms (Hosner & Minckler 1963)

associations.name: Silver maple-sycamore bottomland
associations.where: low first bottoms flooded most springs, silty soil
associations.source: Acer saccharinum floodplain forest (Braun 1950; USNVC Silver Maple-Sycamore Floodplain Forest)

associations.name: Black poplar-white willow riverside wood
associations.where: riverbank levees and islands of European lowland rivers, gravelly alluvium

associations.name: Pecan-cane ridge forest
associations.where: higher natural levees and terraces, rarely flooded, deep loam
associations.source: Mississippi bottomland canebrake and pecan flats (Wharton et al. 1982; Platt & Brantley 1997)
